# LOKEIL Renovation

Interior remodeling company based in Ridgewood, Queens, New York. Company: LOKEIL Inc. Owner: Lorel Beqari.

Services: bathroom remodeling, kitchen remodeling, tile installation, flooring, cabinet installation, plaster and drywall finishing, interior painting, doors, trim, steps, and fireplace finish work.

Service area: Queens, Brooklyn, Manhattan, the Bronx, Staten Island, and parts of Long Island and Westchester County.

Estimate contact: (332) 999-3846 · info@lokeilremodeling.com
